description: This is a unit test file for the llm guard integration within the litellm project. It contains test cases for validating the behavior of the _ENTERPRISE_LLMGuard class, including response moderation, permission checks, and mode configurations.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_LLMGuard
classes.description: A class imported from litellm_enterprise that likely manages LLM guard operations and moderation.

methods.name: test_llm_guard_valid_response()
methods.description: Tests that the LLM guard correctly processes a valid (non-flagged) response without raising exceptions.

methods.name: test_llm_guard_error_raising()
methods.description: Tests that the LLM guard raises an exception when a flagged (invalid) response is processed.

methods.name: test_llm_guard_key_specific_mode()
methods.description: Verifies that the 'key-specific' permission mode correctly allows or blocks processing based on API key permissions.

methods.name: test_llm_guard_request_specific_mode()
methods.description: Verifies that the 'request-specific' permission mode correctly allows or blocks processing based on request metadata permissions.
